HQ_BigHead.wav.en: Sarge, we have reports that the aliens are being led by a larger alien with a big head. Your orders are to take this alien commander out of the picture so we can get the civilian convoy through. Good luck. HQ out.
HQ_BigHead.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_BootCamp.wav.en: Welcome to Boot Camp, Sarge. Here you will learn the tools to help you defeat the Tan and stay in one piece. Make sure to follow the signs and do exactly what they tell you to do. Go for it. HQ out.
HQ_BootCamp.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_CivilianDestination.wav.en: Good job eliminating that alien commander. Now that the path is cleared, you can escort the civilian convoy to their final destination. HQ, out.
HQ_CivilianDestination.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_CivilianSafe.wav.en: The civilians are finally safe. Thanks to you, Sarge.
HQ_CivilianSafe.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_Civilian_Convoy.wav.en: Good work on saving those civilians, Sarge. Unfortunately, we don't have enough manpower to defend this area. You'll have to move the civilians to a safer location before more of those aliens attack. HQ out.
HQ_Civilian_Convoy.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_Congratulations.wav.en: Congratulations, Sarge. Report back to HQ for your first assignment.
HQ_Congratulations.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_FoxTrot.wav.en: Sarge, escort the civilian convoy to Sector Foxtrot Whiskey 1. Secure a safe position and report back to us when your mission is successful. HQ, out.
HQ_FoxTrot.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_Goodwork.wav.en: Good work, Sarge. The area is secure.
HQ_Goodwork.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_INTO_UFO.wav.en: Sarge, this is the area where the UFO landed. We think Plastro has an alliance with something out of this world. We have suspicions that there is more to it than just that ship. Go investigate and try to sneak your way inside the UFO. HQ out.
HQ_INTO_UFO.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_Protectourpeople.wav.en: Sarge, those aliens found another way in. They're rumored to be moving in on the town in your area. You are the only hope for the civilians in this region. Go in, or have a unit go inside each house and order the people living there to run to the old vehicle depot on the south. Let's try and get as many civilians out as possible. Sarge, you're holding all the cards. Good luck. HQ out.
HQ_Protectourpeople.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_RescueHostages.wav.en: Sarge, we found out where your men are being held. Recon can't tell if your men are dead or alive, but they do know your guys are just east of you. There were a lot more TAN in the area than we thought, so I guess the helicopter drop wasn't the best planned out operation. In any case, we're glad you made it out okay. Your guys are tough, and I'm sure they're making TAN's life miserable. Now, go get those guys and clear out the area of any remaining TAN. HQ out.
HQ_RescueHostages.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_SecretBase.wav.en: Sarge, we now know where all those tan are coming from. There seems to be a tan base somewhere in this area. Find and destroy that base. HQ out.
HQ_SecretBase.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_base_history.wav.en: Good work, Sarge. Tan's base is history.
HQ_base_history.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_distress_signal.wav.en: Sarge, we intercepted that message from the walkie-talkie, and it's from someone named Tina Tomorrow. She says she's trapped and needs assistance. She seems to think that unless someone helps her take out some force field generators, the aliens will be here shortly. Aliens? Find her, and help her deactivate the three force field generators so you can both get out of there. HQ out.
HQ_distress_signal.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

HQ_strategic.wav.en: Sarge, take these tanks and secure the three indicated strategic points. By doing so, Tina and her troopers will be able to beam in and reveal why this area seems so important. Make sure Tina succeeds in her mission. HQ, out.
HQ_strategic.wav.speaker: HQ_Command

Sarge_AwayInGo1.wav.en: It's a way in. Go, go, go!
Sarge_AwayInGo1.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_CommanderMe2.wav.en: There's only room for one commander in this battlefield today, and that's me.
Sarge_CommanderMe2.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_DoOrDie3.wav.en: All the chips are down, boys. Time to do or die.
Sarge_DoOrDie3.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_FiringSquad1.wav.en: The firing squad is up to something.
Sarge_FiringSquad1.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_FoxTrot1.wav.en: We have to get to Foxtrot Whiskey One without losing any civilians. Let's roll out!
Sarge_FoxTrot1.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_HowGetThere3.wav.en: How do we get over there?
Sarge_HowGetThere3.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_bootcamp.wav.en: Reporting to boot camp as ordered, sir.
Sarge_bootcamp.wav.speaker: Sarge

Sarge_deadOverlord.wav.en: That's one dead alien overlord who won't bother us again.
Sarge_deadOverlord.wav.speaker: Sarge

SpaceHQ_LargeWaves_t.wav.en: Commander, our scanners indicate large waves of aliens approaching the base from all directions.
SpaceHQ_LargeWaves_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ

SpaceHQ_ReadingsNorth_t.wav.en: Sarge, Tina, this is HQ. Our scanners are picking up some strange reading to the north of your current location. This could be the alien lab we've been looking for. Your mission is to infiltrate the alien lab and upload any useful information about the alien hive from the main computer. HQ out.
SpaceHQ_ReadingsNorth_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ

SpaceHQ_ShowAliens_t.wav.en: Men, let's show these aliens what we're made of.
SpaceHQ_ShowAliens_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ

SpaceHQ_chamber.wav.en: The aliens are supposed to be led by some sort of overlord. It is said to be in those chambers. Take it out, whatever it is. If this mission fails, all of our efforts will have been for nothing. Good luck, and HQ out.
SpaceHQ_chamber.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ

TanUnits_NotSarge1.wav.en: What? No! Not him! Not Sarge!
TanUnits_NotSarge1.wav.speaker: TanArmy

Tina_AlienOverLord.wav.speaker: Tina

Tina_CouldUseHelp.wav.en: I could use some help here.
Tina_CouldUseHelp.wav.speaker: Tina

Tina_ForceField.wav.en: I need to rewire their generators so that we can shut down the force field. Help me find those machines so we can get out of here.
Tina_ForceField.wav.speaker: Tina

Tina_GalacticSoldiers.wav.en: Galactic soldiers, come in. I'm outnumbered and need assistance. I'm in the tunnels beneath their ship. Repeat. Galactic soldiers, come in. I'm outnumbered and need assistance. I'm in the tunnels beneath their ship. Anyone copy?
Tina_GalacticSoldiers.wav.speaker: Tina

Tina_KeepOff.wav.en: Keep those things away from me.
Tina_KeepOff.wav.speaker: Tina

Tina_WayOut.wav.en: There is a way out of here, but we have to take down the force field generators.
Tina_WayOut.wav.speaker: Tina
